gloss: to gather; to assemble; to meet up

definitions.gloss: to gather; to assemble; to meet up at a designated place and time
definitions.explanation: Used when people come together at an agreed location. Common in school, work, and group activity contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{九時|くじ}→九時：10980_kuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{集合|しゅうごう}して⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please meet at the station at nine o'clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{集合|しゅうごう}したら⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}します→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: We'll depart once everyone has gathered.

examples.japanese: ⟦{避難|ひなん}{訓練|くんれん}→避難訓練：28230_hinankunren⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{校庭|こうてい}→校庭：04147_koutei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{集合|しゅうごう}することになっている。
examples.english: During evacuation drills, we're supposed to assemble in the schoolyard.

notes:
Very common in everyday Japanese for organizing group meetups, school events, and workplace gatherings. The noun form ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧ can be used as a command: ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧！(Assemble! / Gather round!). Also used in math for "set" (⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ = set theory).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: meeting time
- ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}{場所|ばしょ}→集合場所：07814_shuugoubasho⟧: meeting place
- ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}{住宅|じゅうたく}→集合住宅：09716_shuugoujuutaku⟧: apartment complex, housing complex

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: to gather (intransitive, more natural/spontaneous)
- ⟦{合流|ごうりゅう}→合流：11902_gouryuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to join up, merge (used when joining an existing group)
